evaluation.state: refined required plan; implementation and acceptance remain incomplete
findings: Hosted historical byte integrity is useful but cannot stand in for a consistent authorized server snapshot or policy transfer.
A manifest hash or copied receipt is insufficient trust; complete journal binding and independently selected key/head are separate gates.
Protection must participate in the same transaction/fence as publication and GC deletion; a background mark list or process-local lease cannot provide that guarantee.
Actual stock client behavior must be tested on each native architecture. A stand-in protocol or GOSUMDB bypass cannot erase DEFECT0126.
A reusable export must cover dependency/proof/policy closure, safe current-policy import and independent consumer recovery. A successful three-file install does not complete those outcomes.
Broad source/native regression cost is justified while shared store/authorization paths change; new native cases belong in existing architecture jobs before adding duplicate local campaigns.
evaluation.next_implementation_boundary: Qualify separate-host native-isolated export consumption, then complete dependency/authority/permission/provenance closure, destination import and full lifecycle/backlog/clock/platform/scale protections.
